rules.message: Reqnroll before 3.2 does not support MSTest 4, and 3.3.4 is current.
rules.fix: Pin each Reqnroll package to 3.3.4 in Directory.Packages.props. On MSTest 3 or xUnit v2 with no upgrade task, suppress with that reason.

rules.message: SpecFlow reached its end of life on 2024-12-31. TechTalk.SpecFlow is the SpecFlow namespace.
rules.fix: Use 'using Reqnroll;' with the Reqnroll packages. Reqnroll.SpecFlowCompatibility keeps the old names only for a first step of the move.

rules.message: ScenarioContext.Current, FeatureContext.Current, and ScenarioStepContext.Current are obsolete and fail in parallel runs.
rules.fix: Inject ScenarioContext, FeatureContext, or a POCO through the constructor of the binding class.
nomatch: public sealed class Hooks(BrowserSession session, ScenarioContext scenario)
var failed = scenario.TestError is not null;

rules.message: A string key in ScenarioContext or FeatureContext has no type check and fails only at run time.
rules.fix: Put the state in a POCO and inject it into each binding class that needs it (context injection).

rules.message: An imperative UI step (click, type, fill) breaks on each change of the screen, and the product owner cannot read it.
rules.fix: Write the behaviour in domain words (When the customer cancels the order). Put the clicks in the step definition.
match: And the user types "100" in the "Amount" field
And I fill in the email field
nomatch: When the customer cancels the order
Then the cancel button is not available

rules.message: A password, key, or token in a feature file goes into Git and into the HTML report.
rules.fix: Write 'Given the customer has signed in'. The step definition reads the test account from environment variables.
nomatch: Given the customer has signed in
Then the user sees the error "Password is too short"
